items.source: ValueStyler that converts objects to String form — generally for debugging purposes — using simple styling conventions that mimic the toString() styling conventions for standard JDK implementations of collections, maps, and arrays.
items.translation: ValueStyler 将对象转换为字符串形式——通常用于调试目的——使用简单的样式约定，模仿标准 JDK 实现中集合、映射和数组的toString()样式约定。

items.source: Uses of DefaultValueStyler in org.springframework.core.style
Support for styling values as Strings, with ToStringCreator as central class.
items.translation: 支持将值作为 String 进行样式化，以 ToStringCreator 为中心类。
